title: Workholding shows on the Setups page when there are no setups, and on neither the Setups nor the Setup<n> page once there is one: it belongs under Fixtures, always

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Reported by the maintainer in chat (2026-11-12, build of main after PR #1114), filed by an agent for him: "bug; when setups has no setups - the workholding is visible in the setups properties. (should be under fixtures) and they go away from both Setups and Setup<n> properties panel. Which is inconsistent".

**What happens today**
- A document with NO setups: selecting **Setups** in the browser shows "Create first setup" and, under it, the whole workholding block ("Workholding in this setup's collision checks", the fixture plate rows, Import fixture, Add built-in vise, Add accessory, Add fixture plate) and the tool list. PR #1114 kept this on purpose ("the implicit context has no Setup<n> node to hold these").
- As soon as a setup exists: the block is gone from the Setups page (as #1104 asked) and, as he sees it, it is not on the Setup<n> properties panel either - workholding is then found only under the browser's **Fixtures** node.

So the same thing lives in two different places depending on whether a setup exists, and in one state it sits on a page whose job is the setup list.

**Wanted - one home.** Workholding is edited under **Fixtures**, in every state:
- The Setups page never shows the workholding block, with or without setups. With no setups it shows "Create first setup" and the short text that the one stock and work origin act as the first setup - nothing else (decide the tool list the same way: it belongs under Tool list, not on Setups; say what you did).
- The browser shows a **Fixtures** row (and Tool list row) for the implicit first setup too, so the no-setup document has the same place to click as a document with setups. If the browser cannot show those rows without a setup node today, that is the thing to fix; do not hide workholding in the no-setup document.
- The Setup<n> page: check what it shows today (its Fixtures tab/section from `setup_pages.rs`) against what he sees ("they go away from ... Setup<n> properties panel"). Either workholding is reachable from the Setup<n> page in one obvious click (a "Fixtures" row or button that opens the Fixtures page for that setup), or it is not there at all and the page says where it is - pick one and make the three states (no setups / one setup / several) behave the same.
- No command changes: every control keeps queueing the same undoable command.

Done means: in a no-setup document, a one-setup document and a two-setup document, the workholding block is found in the same place (Fixtures) and nowhere else; the Setups page shows no workholding in any of the three; pinned in the structural tests for all three states (labels present and absent per page, the browser rows present); no snapshot PNG touched.
